# Add i18n to a project

kapi's goal for i18n is **zero toil**: after adoption, a developer ships a
feature in every language by writing plain source-language text, and translation
is an ambient consequence of a source change — extraction, sync, QA, and fill
happen in the build and CI, never as a chore someone remembers. Every framework
this skill knows is graded on how close it gets (the **Toil Index**, below); your
job is to (1) detect the stack, (2) install the *recommended configuration*
that earns the framework its grade — not the stock setup — and (3) warn the
user honestly when their stack can't get below T3.

## Step 1 — detect the stack

Consult [i18n/frameworks.yaml](i18n/frameworks.yaml) — the registry of every
framework this skill knows: detection signals (`detect.deps` in
package.json/pubspec/Gemfile/go.mod/csproj, `detect.files` markers), catalog
layout, the kapi preset and flags to use, toil scores, and status
(`recommended`/`supported`/`caution`/`avoid`). Check dependency manifests and
marker files against it. `kapi init --list-presets` shows the presets kapi can
scaffold directly.

|---|---|

# React / Next.js i18n — adoption playbook

Grades are the recommended-config Toil Index (see [../i18n.md](../i18n.md);
scores in [frameworks.yaml](frameworks.yaml)).

| Stack | Grade | One-liner |
|---|---|---|
| **neokapi-i18n** | **T0** | Plain JSX is the catalog; bundler extracts at build time. The greenfield default. |
| next-intl | T2 | The Next.js App Router standard; IDs + hand-authored catalogs, best RSC ergonomics. |
| Lingui | T2 | Source-as-key macros + PO catalogs; lowest marking cost of the runtime libs. |
| react-i18next | T2 | The incumbent; biggest ecosystem, key hygiene forever. |
| next-i18next | T2 | Only for existing i18next investments on Next.js (v16 revived it). |
| react-intl | **T3 — warn** | Maximum boilerplate + hash-ID churn; right only with an ICU/TMS mandate. |

**Opinionated defaults:** greenfield React (Vite/webpack) → **neokapi-i18n**.
Next.js App Router with no i18n yet → **next-intl** (neokapi-i18n works via the
webpack hook, but next-intl is the ecosystem-native choice — offer both).
Team wants source-as-key with a classic library → **Lingui**. Existing
library already installed → keep it, install its recommended config below.
